name: Chetana local rules and entity extraction
use_for: OTP, UPI, APK, remote-access, KYC, digital-arrest, job, courier, and merchant patterns
limitations: Pattern matching is advisory and cannot prove that an identifier is clean.
Needs periodic refresh from real incident reports and sponsor feedback.

name: Google Safe Browsing API
use_for: thin link risk before a user opens a site
limitations: URL-only signal; does not verify UPI IDs, phone numbers, screenshots, or caller intent.
Requires API key, quota governance, and privacy review before sending user-submitted URLs.

name: abuse.ch URLhaus
use_for: local denylist seeding for suspicious links
limitations: Focused on malware infrastructure, not consumer scam persuasion.
A missing hit must never be treated as safe.

name: PhishTank
limitations: Community feed quality and freshness vary.
Does not cover phone, UPI, QR intent, or screenshot-only scams.

name: OpenPhish
limitations: The richer feed/API is commercial.
A no-match is not a clean verdict.

name: VirusTotal API v3
use_for: APK hash or file reputation checks when user consent allows
limitations: Submitting files or URLs to a third party requires clear consent and privacy classification.
Free/public quotas and licensing constraints are not suitable for high-volume public scanning.

name: urlscan.io
limitations: Public scans can expose submitted URLs and metadata unless configured carefully.
Not appropriate for private bank links or sensitive screenshots by default.

name: National Cyber Crime Portal suspect repository
use_for: manual lookup of phone numbers, UPI IDs, account numbers, and suspicious identifiers
official second check when identifiers are extracted
limitations: No stable public API is treated as available.
Complaint-based lookup is not a definitive safe/unsafe verdict.

name: Sanchar Saathi Chakshu
use_for: suspected fraud communication reports by call, SMS, or WhatsApp before money is lost
limitations: Not a general cybercrime complaint replacement.
If money is lost, Chetana must still route to 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in first.

name: The420.in
use_for: human review of India cybercrime trends
limitations: No stable public machine API observed.
Editorial reports must not be used as automated verdict ground truth.
The420 Search Engine was observed as a site feature, not a confirmed API.

name: Reserve Bank of India public guidance and CMS
limitations: Policy guidance, not a live scam identifier database.
Chetana should summarize and route, not provide legal advice.
